00.text: A quick guide to the Template Builder.

01.text: Build a Service Agreement template on one screen.

03.text: Content can hold three kinds of variables.

05.text: Sections on the left, the editor in the middle, the preview on the right.

06.text: Pick a template here, or start a new one.

10.text: Add a new section, or reuse one from the library.

13.text: Custom fields hold data that changes per agreement.

16.text: The fee schedule lists the default fees of the template.

18.text: It replaces the built-in fees of every service that uses the template.

25.text: Save stores everything in one go. Cancel goes back to the saved version.

02.text: Sections, custom fields, a fee schedule and a live A4 preview.

04.text: Fees are data, never typed text. The engine calculates the tables.

07.text: A new template starts empty, or as a copy of the sections of another.

08.text: Drag to reorder sections. Untick one to hide it from the agreement.

09.text: Any change shows Unsaved changes, with Cancel and Save.

11.text: Edit the section in the Visual editor, or switch to HTML.

12.text: Page options: start on a new page, or keep the section on one page.

14.text: Save stays disabled until every field has a valid name and key.

15.text: The key is made from the label. Choose a type, a default, and whether it is required.

17.text: Set the amount, how it is charged, GST, and whether staff can change it.

19.text: Use the Insert bar to place a field in the text, at the cursor.

20.text: Without a default, the preview shows the field label in brackets.

21.text: For fees, add a section and insert the Full fee schedule and Totals.

22.text: The preview uses sample data: Jane Sample, one partner and one child.

23.text: Each fee is the amount times the number of people, plus GST if ticked.

24.text: $2,200 plus $1,000 plus $100: a grand total of $3,300.

26.text: Staff then see the template's fields and fees when they create an agreement.

27.text: Each agreement keeps a snapshot, so later template edits do not change it.

28.text: Fees are data. Shared sections change everywhere. Nothing is live until Save.
